how: Shanghai has hundreds of escape-room venues such as MC Puzzle Room and Mofang Secret Room, most run in Mandarin, with some English-friendly or translator-on-request options.
JM Pilates in Yangpu offers private and small-group reformer pilates classes taught in Chinese, Korean and English.
Occasional D&D 5e events are listed on Meetup for Shanghai and a board-game guild meets weekly near Jing'an Temple, but no confirmed current regular D&D group was found.

how: Shanghai has esports-themed venues such as the ESP eSports Experience Center and IMBA eSports Center at Global Harbor Mall in Putuo, plus many internet-bar gaming halls.

activity: Artisan bread and pastry baking courses
how: Shanghai Young Bakers Baking Center runs public bread classes such as a baguette and milky-bread course at its centre near Qilianshan Road on Line 11.
Pub quiz nights run in Shanghai, including weekly quizzes at bars such as The Camel and chamber-of-commerce quiz nights at BritCham Shanghai After Hours.
Hackathons in Shanghai are occasional, such as the French Tech Shanghai team hackathon and NYU Shanghai's HackShanghai, alongside an Indie Hackers builders meetup.
Shanghai Birding runs a WeChat group and led trips to Cape Nanhui, while the Shanghai Wild Bird Society and studios run beginner outings at Century Park and Gongqing Forest Park.
Language Exchangers Shanghai holds weekly Friday and Sunday meetups where German is among the practised languages, though no dedicated German course was confirmed.
